classification_rule: Source structure without a same-type corresponding current structure is work. Drawing whitespace and display-registration residuals are not construction polygons.
display_limitations: The directly user-accepted R07 OP067 point is exact in the display transform. Rotation derives from physical native cap axes; their source identities are not fitted. Scale derives from repeated native stair row stations relative to this fixed point.

The candidate lower four-ring rectangle has incompatible x/y scale ratios and source identity conflicts. Its large residuals under the approved-anchor fit are explicit; the rejected cap-only fit is retained as competing evidence, not selected.

Native boarding stair row constraints use approximate bay station/order, not exact source-centre to native-upper-tread point identities. Along-flight coordinates are excluded; scale remains a best-estimate display constraint.
Peripheral source outlines and distant regions are extrapolated. Missing-work classification must not interpret registration mismatch as a missing wall automatically.
No exact source/native core EV or whole-perimeter bijection has been established; no model-based C70 intermediate planes are introduced to hide that gap.
